meta.title: WorkLingo System Atlas
meta.scope: apps, packages, scripts, infra, existing docs, optional .github and selected root configuration; actual working-tree snapshot with per-file hashes
excluded: existing binary media and log files
limitations: VERIFIED means the specific source declaration or reviewed rule has evidence; it does not mean runtime-tested or deployed.
Structural file coverage is not behavioral or code-test coverage.
Curated behavior covers selected flows; every module remains PARTIALLY_ANALYZED.
No production test suite or database mutation was executed.
